Subject: Cross-zone liaison roster & skill-swap playbook — July interview push

Team —

We have a block of 28 onsite-style interview slots for Acme next week (Jul 6–9) and the hiring manager asked for coverage plans that tolerate TZ skews and two last-minute cancellations. Goals: keep candidate debriefs within 24 hours, avoid repeating the same interviewer across candidates, and have an on-call liaison for each morning window (US morning / EU afternoon).

Quick asks:
- Can each of you take one morning liaison shift (8–11am PT) during the week? The liaison is the single point to collect immediate debrief notes and escalate any no-shows.
- Ben — can you prepare a standby CSV of 6 fallback interviewers (pref skills + timezone)?
- Marissa — can you validate the skill-swap matrix against the fullstack rubric and flag any single-skill gaps?
- Lauren — I need a short playbook (<=1 page) for swapping interviewers mid-day (what to brief, how to reassign follow-ups).

I’ve attached an initial liaison grid and a draft swap checklist. If you can reply with confirmed shifts by EOD tomorrow (Jun 30), I’ll publish the final rota and ping talent to confirm candidate times.

Thanks —
Sofia

Swap playbook (summary I’m sending to talent):
- If an interviewer cancels with >8 hours notice: liaison reassigns to primary-secondary and updates the sheet.
- If cancel <8 hours: liaison triggers standby ladder, informs hiring manager and updates calendar.
- Debrief form: 1) Recommend (Yes/No/Maybe) 2) Top 2 strengths 3) Top concern 4) Immediate follow-up (homework/test/code link).

Attachments included when I send to Acme: liaison-grid-v1.xlsx, standby-roster.csv, playbook-swap-notes.pdf. I’ll send the candidate-facing schedule by 10:45 PT. Please flag any issues now — otherwise I’ll publish and loop Talent.
